summary: Verified FromPrice ('Desde €… por persona') block on every card of the 4 home category carousels and confirmed it is NOT present in the 'Próximas salidas' (upcoming) carousel. Popover breakdown opens on hover; clicking on the price does NOT navigate to the trip page. Tested on desktop (1920x4000) and mobile (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: HomeCategoryCarousel.jsx: FromPrice is correctly rendered only when !compactMeta, using tone={isDark?'light':'dark'} size='md' and routeId={trip.routeId}, matching the catalog formatting requirement.
FromPrice.jsx: stopPropagation on the trigger span and PopoverContent click prevent unwanted navigation when the trigger lives inside a wrapping <Link>. Verified click on price did not change URL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested 4 home category carousels (home-south-carousel, home-full-carousel, home-short-carousel, home-north-carousel) — each has 5 cards, all with data-testid 'home-trip-from-<id>' rendering 'Desde €… por persona'. The upcoming carousel (home-upcoming-carousel) has 6 cards and NONE include FromPrice — only the legacy inline 'desde N€' beside the CTA arrow. Breakdown popover (home-trip-from-<id>-breakdown) shows on hover. Click on the price node does NOT navigate (stays on /). Mobile viewport tested — FromPrice present on first card of each carousel. No JS console errors observed.
